exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Earth route:6 mathematics courses45 EC,4 programming/data courses30 EC,13 environment/sustainability courses97.5 EC and PPD7.5 EC. The environmental courses have real waves/materials, geoscience, climate and energy content, but do not provide sustained mechanics/electromagnetism/quantum/astronomy or physics laboratory work. Brain route:12 mathematics/programming/data/statistical/research-synthesis courses90 EC,10 brain/biomedical/development courses75 EC, philosophy7.5 EC and PPD7.5 EC. Neurobiology/perception and LTI signal methods are genuine contributions; generic image processing is not physical instrumentation, biological development is not neurophysics and linear time-invariant systems is not nonlinear dynamics/chaos. Both48 original placements pass actual prerequisites/offerings; scheduling feasibility does not establish comparability.

candidateAssessment.label: Neuroscience, perception & quantitative modelling
candidateAssessment.reason: Biological neuroscience and perception are genuine but do not supply the physical theory and measurement that define neurophysics.

candidateAssessment.label: Astronomy & astrophysics
candidateAssessment.reason: UCR has image processing, Earth observation and quantitative methods, but no astronomy, stellar or planetary physics, relativity, gravitation or observational-astronomy sequence. These methods cannot sustain a complete astronomy curriculum.

candidateAssessment.label: Fundamental & experimental physics
candidateAssessment.reason: UCR lacks mechanics, electromagnetism, optics, thermodynamics, quantum theory, relativity and an experimental-physics laboratory sequence. Mathematics, modelling and Earth science are related contributions, not replacements for this cumulative core.

candidateAssessment.label: Atomic & molecular physics
candidateAssessment.reason: Biochemistry and computational methods do not supply atomic structure, molecular spectroscopy, quantum mechanics or the required physics laboratory foundation.

candidateAssessment.label: High-energy & particle physics
candidateAssessment.reason: UCR offers no particle physics, gravitational physics, quantum field theory or preceding mechanics and electromagnetism sequence.

candidateAssessment.label: Solid-state & condensed-matter physics
candidateAssessment.reason: Environmental materials courses do not provide electronic structure, crystallography, quantum mechanics, solid-state physics or experimental condensed-matter work.

candidateAssessment.label: Physics education
candidateAssessment.reason: UCR lacks the undergraduate physics content and physics didactics needed for a coherent teaching-physics route; the limitation is academic preparation, not qualification alone.

audience.programmeDescription: Physics and Astronomy at Radboud studies the physical laws of matter and the universe through theory, mathematics, computation and experiments. The Dutch-taught bachelor develops mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, quantum physics and astronomy, concluding with an individual research internship.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers useful connections through mathematics, programming, data science, Earth systems and neuroscience. These courses do not support a complete programme centred on the physical theories and experimental methods that define Physics and Astronomy. We therefore show Radboud’s curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

curriculum.limitation: The 180 EC programme comprises 60 EC in the first year, 69 EC of later required courses, 39 EC of eligible elective/minor space and a 12 EC individual research internship. The optional astronomy minor, dual degree and older-cohort substitutions are separate. First-year PPD and the later portfolio each carry 3 EC. The required Dutch academic-language diagnostic adds no credits; participation, rather than passing, is required.
